name: CG SEMI PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: CG Semi is playing a strategic role in India's drive toward self-reliance in semiconductor manufacturing with significant planned investments and job creation.
summary: CG Semi Private Limited, part of the Murugappa Group, focuses on semiconductor assembly, testing, and packaging. The company is investing over USD 1 billion to establish facilities with a production capacity of over 4 billion units annually, aiming to enhance India's position in the global semiconductor supply chain.
